text.description_html:
Schlage FE489WBCCEN, Century Handleset Grip with Century Encode Smart WiFi Deadbolt

The Century Handleset with Encode Smart WiFi Deadbolt features built-in WiFi which allows you to lock/unlock from anywhere. Set up guest access codes for recurring, temporary or permanent access when paired with the Schlage Home app or Key by Amazon app, no additional accessories required. For additional convenience, enjoy voice commands via Alexa or Google Assistant. Create and manage up to 100 access codes for trusted friends and family to use with the fingerprint-resistant, capacitive touchscreen with easy one-touch locking. Built-in alarm technology senses potential security breaches at the lock. Low battery indicator offers weeks of advanced warning for battery replacement. Easy to install with just a screwdriver. Unique Snap n Stay technology snaps the deadbolt onto the door so both hands are free during installation. Will fit most standard doors (1-3/8 inches to 1-3/4 inches door thicknesses and 2-3/8 inches or 2-3/4 inches backsets). The Schlage Century Handleset with Encode Lock works with Schlage Home, Key by Amazon, Alexa, Ring, and Google Assistant.

Features of the Schlage Century Handleset with Encode Deadbolt:

  • ANSI/BHMI Grade 1
  • ADA Compliant
  • Uses 4 AA alkaline batteries.
  • Keying: 5-pin tumbler, C Keyway, 1 key included
  • Operating Temperatures: Outside escutcheon: -35C to 66C,Inside escutcheon: -10C to 49C
  • WiFi compatibility: requires 2.4GHz WiFi network
  • Codes: Pre-set, unique 6-digit programming code, two pre-set unique 4-digit access codes, 100 code capacity
  • 3 screw door frame reinforcer.
  • All metal chassis for strength and durability.
  • Outside Trim: Handlesets are solid forged brass; wrought brass trim rings with concealed security inserts.
  • Inside Trim: are zinc-based plated to match finishes indicated.

Specifications of the Wifi Century Handleset:

  • Rage of Door Preparation: 4" to 5-1/2"
  • Exterior Total Projection: 2-1/4"
  • Exterior Center to Center Grip Range: adjustable 8-1/2" to 9-3/4"
  • Exterior Top Grip Escutcheon Width: 2-1/2"
  • Exterior Grip Height: 11-7/8"
  • Exterior Deadbolt Plate Width: 3"
  • Exterior Deadbolt Plate Height: 5"
  • Interior Deadbolt Plate Width: 3"
  • Interior Deadbolt Plate Height: 5-1/2"
  • Interior Deadbolt Plate Projection: 2.2"
  • Door Thickness: 1-3/8" to 1-3/4"
  • Backset: will fit 2-3/8" or 2-3/4"

Custom item, NOT Returnable
